guidance.title: Setup rules
guidance.subtitle: These are the operating rules behind the setup page and the schema update.
guidance.ruleOneText: The main app owns `aihr_assessment_cycles`; Lab 12 should reference it instead of redefining cycle labels.
guidance.ruleTwoText: Cycle labels should come from `default_label` plus translation overrides, not from hardcoded UI strings.
guidance.ruleThreeText: The optional capstone table should be `aihr_employee_assessments` keyed by `cycle_code`.
